title: Onboard LucentX-30B v1.0: perf profiles, metadata, and changelog automation
author: Ava Chen
description: Motivation: Add LucentX-30B v1.0 to the model registry with canonical metadata, performance profiles for the Redwood serving runtime, and automated changelog/release note generation. This PR includes model metadata (architecture, vocab, tokenizer hints), precomputed perf profiles for common sequence-length buckets and batch sizes, and an update to the changelog automation so onboarding entries are generated as part of the registry CI job. Changes: 1) models/lucentx/metadata.json - new model metadata including model_id, architecture, parameters, supported precisions, recommended quantization and KV cache behavior. 2) perf_profiles/lucentx-30b-v1.0.yaml - perf profile with p95 latency and throughput measurements across T4/A10/GPU types, recommended batch sizes and prefix caching suggestions. 3) scripts/generate-changelog.py - extend automation to pick up new model metadata tags and emit structured release notes for the docs site. 4) docs/models/lucentx.md - initial model page with quickstart and known limitations. 5) tests/integration/test_lucentx_registry.py - integration tests that validate registry metadata surface and perf profile parsing. Testing and validation: CI runs include lint, unit tests, registry integration, and a perf sanity check that compares measured throughput to profile thresholds. I validated profiles by running the perf harness on a small pilot pool (A10 and T4) and the results are included in the commit messages. Backwards compatibility: metadata fields are additive and follow the existing schema; changelog automation has a feature flag so the automation can be staged. Rollout plan: merge to main, the changelog automation will remain behind the feature flag for one week while we monitor the daily registry CI runs. Linked work: ENG-4122 adds model onboarding checklist and perf harness improvements; PM-934 tracks product documentation for LucentX. Checklist: [x] Metadata JSON added [x] Perf profiles added and validated [x] Changelog automation extended [x] Docs page added [x] Integration tests added
